Can you confirm the primary intake contact (for uploads and QnA follow-ups) and a secondary contact for escalations?

If possible, please upload the SAML XML to the portal (I can open a staging ticket) or share over a secure link.

I'll open a portal ticket with ID CF-79231 and will loop back when the bundle is ready for our intake.

Hi all — attaching the SP metadata and the bridge notes. Quick notes inline:

- saml-metadata.xml (attached) — we sign assertions with our intermediate key; your SP should accept issuer 'https://auth.redwood.com/saml'.
- soc2-bridge-notes.pdf (attached) — 1.5 pages, maps our controls and hosting variants (hosted API / dedicated pools / private) to relevant CAIQ sections.
- TTL: we can do 7 days for the staging upload; production evidence exchanges will use a long-lived signed manifest and S3 proof possession where appropriate.

Ben: naming convention we use for portal uploads is: redwood_<org>_<evidence-type>_<yyyyMMdd>.pdf (example: redwood_cloudforge_caiq_20270427.pdf). If CloudForge needs different convention we can adapt.
